notes: Field names here MUST match RuntimeAssets.kt, which parses id, path, url,
sha256, sizeBytes, required and installMode. An earlier revision of this
file used name/size/target/mode instead, which the parser silently
ignored: every asset dropped out, the manifest loaded empty, and the
sizeBytes integrity check degraded to 'skip' because it parsed as 0.
ProotWrapContractTest now pins these key names so that drift fails a unit
test instead of only surfacing on a device.
The bionic Node runtime does NOT come from here. It ships inside the APK:
the interpreter is a jniLib (so AGP extracts it to nativeLibraryDir, the
only app location where execve is permitted at targetSdk 29+), and its
shared libraries are assets under assets/nativelibs, unpacked to filesDir
and located via LD_LIBRARY_PATH. Build both with
PRoot + this rootfs remain the fallback runtime path.

assets.description: PRoot 5.3.0, static aarch64. Runs the musl/Alpine guest inside the app sandbox.
Alpine 3.22 aarch64 (musl 1.2.5) with Node at /usr/bin/node. Patch the musl loader with tools/patch-musl-faccessat2.py before repacking, then recompute this sha256 and sizeBytes.
